scope: Cached hunts tied to or predating superseded GenLayer deployments; no chain or token transactions were sent.

investigations.note: Legacy Base escrow registration remains on-chain and was not modified. The active API is configured to EDFF and cannot settle this older A239 registration.

method: Single PostgreSQL transaction with row locks and guards that required the exact four stale IDs and Base case IDs, plus the current investigation 1 in open CHALLENGE_WINDOW state. Transaction would roll back if any guard failed.

liveReverification.method: Read-only Fly machine config and production PostgreSQL queries; public API GET /health and GET /investigations?limit=100
liveReverification.result: No cached hunts or dependent cache records from a previous contract were present. The three rows in the active feed are read from the configured EDFF deployment; they are not deleted because their current-contract Base escrow/challenge records are unsettled.

limitations: The cache schema did not store the source GenLayer contract address, so stale investigations were identified by pre-EDFF creation records and cross-checked against Base escrow registrations. The active investigation was protected by exact case ID and state guards.
Deleting cache rows does not delete or settle any on-chain Base or GenLayer state.
The legacy investigation 2 Base registration and its 100,000 USDC base-unit bounty remain on-chain and require a separately supported legacy recovery or settlement path.
